summary: Looks at the security threats of the 6to4 IPv6 transition mechanism from RFC 3056. Because 6to4 routers accept IPv6-in-IPv4 traffic from any node, threats include denial of service and easier spoofing of IPv6 addresses. The memo discusses how to mitigate them.

eli5.summary: A door that opens for anyone who knocks can be abused. This memo lists the ways a bad guy could misuse the 6to4 door and how to guard it.
